item.title: PGTI's Kapil Dev, Amandeep Johl Meet Tourism Minister To Discuss Golf, Tourism
item.description: Tourism Gajendra Singh Shekhawat: Amandeep Singh Johl and Kapil Dev, the CEO and President respectively of the Professional Golf Tour of India (PGTI), met Union Minister of Culture and Tourism Gajendra Singh Shekhawat to discuss the development of golf and tourism in the country.

item.title: Lakshya Cup 2025 To Feature India’s Top Air Rifle Shooters In Navi Mumbai
item.description: Tara Chand Infralogistic Solutions Ltd: India’s top 20 shooters in 10m Air Rifle will compete for the honours in the 16th Lakshya Cup at the Lakshya Shooting Club, Karnala Sports Academy, in Navi Mumbai, hoping to continue their buildup for the trials for the teams for this year's mega event -- the Asian Games in Japan.

item.title: T20 WC: Italy Opt To Bowl Against Unchanged WI In Final Group C Match
item.description: T20 World Cup: Italy have won the toss and opted to bowl against West Indies in their final group stage match of the T20 World Cup 2026 here at the Eden Gardens Stadium on Thursday.

item.title: Champions League: Leverkusen, Bodo/Glimt, Newcastle Win In Knockout Phase Play-off First Legs
item.description: First Jens Petter Hauge: Leverkusen, Newcastle and Bodo/Glimt all picked up wins in the first legs of their UEFA Champions League knockout phase play-offs.

item.title: T20 WC: All Stats From India's 17-run Win Over Netherlands
item.description: But Shivam Dube: India head into Super Eights with an unbeaten record after beating Netherlands by 17 runs in their last Group A fixture.

item.title: Alcaraz Sets QF With Khachanov In Doha
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz: Carlos Alcaraz progressed to Qatar Open quarterfinal with a straight sets 6-2, 7-5 win over Valentin Royer.

item.title: New Zealand Batter Lauren Down Announces Retirement
item.description: New Zealand Cricket: New Zealand batter Lauren Down has called time on her 15-year cricket career at the age of 30. She played 35 ODIs and 13 T20Is for the White Ferns since her international debut in 2018.

item.title: India’s Cricket Economy Is Evolving as IPL Fans Turn to Digital Gaming
item.description: Cricket is growing from strength to strength every year, so fans are looking to get involved with their predictions on who they think will win the entire tournament before engaging with each individual game.

item.title: T20 WC: ‘Mahi Bhai Told Me It’s Not Necessary To Hit Sixes Every Time,' Says Dube After Match-winning Knock Against Netherlands
item.description: Narendra Modi Stadium: India all-rounder Shivam Dube credited former skipper MS Dhoni for bringing clarity to his batting approach after he played a match-winning 67-run knock against the Netherlands at the Narendra Modi Stadium on Wednesday.
